ackr-bound-probe.description: A probe to give an upper bound of Ackermann congruence lemmas that a formula might generate.

is-unbounded.description: true if the goal contains integer/real constants that do not have lower/upper bounds.

is-pb.description: true if the goal is a pseudo-boolean problem.

arith-max-deg.description: max polynomial total degree of an arithmetic atom.

arith-avg-deg.description: avg polynomial total degree of an arithmetic atom.

is-qflia.description: true if the goal is in QF_LIA.

is-qfauflia.description: true if the goal is in QF_AUFLIA.

is-qflra.description: true if the goal is in QF_LRA.

is-qflira.description: true if the goal is in QF_LIRA.

is-ilp.description: true if the goal is ILP.

is-qfnia.description: true if the goal is in QF_NIA (quantifier-free nonlinear integer arithmetic).

is-qfnra.description: true if the goal is in QF_NRA (quantifier-free nonlinear real arithmetic).

is-nia.description: true if the goal is in NIA (nonlinear integer arithmetic, formula may have quantifiers).

is-nra.description: true if the goal is in NRA (nonlinear real arithmetic, formula may have quantifiers).

is-nira.description: true if the goal is in NIRA (nonlinear integer and real arithmetic, formula may have quantifiers).

is-lia.description: true if the goal is in LIA (linear integer arithmetic, formula may have quantifiers).

is-lra.description: true if the goal is in LRA (linear real arithmetic, formula may have quantifiers).

is-lira.description: true if the goal is in LIRA (linear integer and real arithmetic, formula may have quantifiers).

is-qfufnra.description: true if the goal is QF_UFNRA (quantifier-free nonlinear real arithmetic with other theories).

is-qfbv-eq.description: true if the goal is in a fragment of QF_BV which uses only =, extract, concat.

is-qffp.description: true if the goal is in QF_FP (floats).

is-qffpbv.description: true if the goal is in QF_FPBV (floats+bit-vectors).

is-qffplra.description: true if the goal is in QF_FPLRA.

memory.description: amount of used memory in megabytes.

size.description: number of assertions in the given goal.

num-exprs.description: number of expressions/terms in the given goal.

num-consts.description: number of non Boolean constants in the given goal.

num-bool-consts.description: number of Boolean constants in the given goal.

num-arith-consts.description: number of arithmetic constants in the given goal.

num-bv-consts.description: number of bit-vector constants in the given goal.

produce-proofs.description: true if proof generation is enabled for the given goal.

produce-model.description: true if model generation is enabled for the given goal.

produce-unsat-cores.description: true if unsat-core generation is enabled for the given goal.

has-quantifiers.description: true if the goal contains quantifiers.

has-patterns.description: true if the goal contains quantifiers with patterns.

is-propositional.description: true if the goal is in propositional logic.

is-qfbv.description: true if the goal is in QF_BV.

is-qfaufbv.description: true if the goal is in QF_AUFBV.

is-quasi-pb.description: true if the goal is quasi-pb.
